findings.disposition: Denies socket connect, connect_ex, create_connection and DNS resolution.
Requires nonempty requested-to-returned map identity; detects historical empty maps.
Requires marking IDs and corresponding permission context.
Accounts for successful and invalid classification input independently.
Separates valid USE/DECLASSIFY from Organization ADMINISTER rejection and final-administrator removal rejection.
